g.text: 90% KDE regions; 50 observations per taxon; shared axes within each module
Illustrative single resample, not the 30-resample median. Lower panels are silhouettes, not 2D 90% regions.
Involucre is an incomplete 3D projection. Smoothed image phenotypes include photographic and measurement variation.
